sample.question:
The robot R moves on adjacent tower tops. It may climb up by at most 1 level unless a ladder connects the two towers; it may descend freely. Starting from R, after the move sequence right, down, up, up, left, where does the robot end up?
Options:
[1] (1, 1)
[2] (1, 2)
[3] (1, 3)
[4] (2, 3)
[5] (2, 1)
[6] (1, 4)
[7] (2, 4)
[8] (2, 2)
sample.analysis:
Move 1 right: moved from (2, 1) to (2, 2) because normal height rule.
Move 2 down: moved from (2, 2) to (3, 2) because normal height rule.
Move 3 up: moved from (3, 2) to (2, 2) because normal height rule.
Move 4 up: moved from (2, 2) to (1, 2) because normal height rule.
Move 5 left: moved from (1, 2) to (1, 1) because normal height rule.
Final coordinate is (1, 1). Therefore choose option 1.

state_content.rules: Move between adjacent towers. Climb up at most 1 level normally; ladder edges allow climbing up 2 levels. Descending is always allowed.

Final coordinate is (1, 1). Therefore choose option 1.
